snippet.title: Bluey's Happy Snaps | "Play For Real Life" Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Bring Bluey's wild and wonderful world into focus next month with Bluey's Happy Snaps, releasing 15th October! 📸

Available to pre-order now: https://www.gameloft.com/game/bluey

Using Dad's old camera, two players can explore and play as Bluey and Bingo, as you capture memorable moments across real locations from the show. Then take the fun off-screen and keep playing... for real life! 💙🧡

Save your dollarbucks and preorder now to get the Deluxe Edition with "Here Come the Grannies!" game mode at no extra cost! (Beans not included)
